audit_boundary: Finite exhaustive enumeration validates only the identity and verifier. It is not promoted as the FPT discovery algorithm.
claim_boundary: C048.1 closes the abstract fixed-k layout-discovery existence question by exact identification with a published constructive FPT theorem. It does not claim the repository reimplements that constructor, does not prove bounded k on every instance, does not close NAND3+NEQ, and does not resolve P versus NP.
composition_theorem: Composing the published fixed-k layout constructor with C047 yields f(k)*2^O(k)*poly(L) exact affine-avoidance compilation on arrangements of linear-layout width at most k. For every fixed k this is polynomial; it is not a universal polynomial algorithm when k is unbounded.
exact_identity: For every factor order pi, the C047 width max_t dim((sum_{j<=t} N_pi(j)) intersect (sum_{j>t} N_pi(j))) is exactly the linear-layout width of the same GF(2) subspace arrangement used by Jeong-Kim-Oum.
proof_carrying_gap: Reimplement or bind the published constructor so FOUND and NO_LAYOUT_AT_CAP terminals, all failed probes, work, and layout certificates are independently replayable.

published_constructor.extended_title: The art of trellis decoding is fixed-parameter tractable
published_constructor.guarantee: Construct a linear layout of width at most k if one exists, in fixed-parameter tractable total work parameterized by k.
published_constructor.title: Constructive algorithm for path-width of matroids
